packageRules.description: Group the bundled tool bumps (immich-go, supercronic, alpine) into one PR
Group CI action bumps (build + lint workflows) into one PR
supercronic's ARG carries a pinned SHA256 next to the version; a version-only bump fails the build's checksum step by design. Do not automerge — update SUPERCRONIC_SHA256 in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Update `SUPERCRONIC_SHA256` from the release's checksum file in this PR, or the image build fails at the sha256sum check.

customManagers.description: Track the `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` + `ARG X_VERSION=` pairs in the Dockerfile. config:recommended does not read these comments — the built-in dockerfile manager only sees FROM/COPY --from — so immich-go 0.32.0 (2026-06) went unnoticed until Immich v3 broke every run.
